types.state: args of the current call + LATEST DB objects seen in any tool output (Python)
types.tool_log: earlier tool calls and their results (Python)
types.structural: format of the current agent turn (Python)
types.dialogue: content of user/agent messages (LLM judge; spec only, not implemented in Step 2)

signature: (tool_call: dict, trajectory: list, config: dict) -> bool | None  (None = not enough information)

predicates.name: single_tool_call_in_turn
predicates.description: the current agent turn contains exactly one tool call

inputs.turn: the assistant message that contains the current call (tool_call['turn'])

predicates.computation: len(turn.tool_calls) == 1. None if the turn is not provided.

predicates.name: text_with_tool_call
predicates.description: the current agent turn has user-facing text AND at least one tool call
predicates.computation: turn.content is a non-empty string after strip() AND turn.tool_calls is non-empty. None if the turn is not provided.

predicates.name: all_new_flights_available
predicates.description: every newly booked flight-date was seen in a search result with status 'available'
predicates.computation: New segments = all args.flights (book) or args.flights minus the reservation's current (flight_number, date) multiset (update). For each: info = latest search result for (flight_number, date); None if never seen; False if info.status != 'available'. True if all are available. Searches only return available flights, so 'seen' implies 'available' in τ-bench v1.

predicates.name: passenger_count_at_most_five
predicates.description: the booking has at most five passengers
predicates.computation: len(args.passengers) <= 5. None if passengers is not a list.

predicates.name: all_passengers_have_name_and_dob
predicates.description: every passenger has a non-empty first name, last name and date of birth
predicates.computation: All three fields are non-empty strings for every passenger. None if passengers is not a list.

predicates.name: passengers_share_flights_and_cabin
predicates.description: the booking has one cabin and one flight list shared by all passengers
predicates.computation: isinstance(cabin, str) AND isinstance(flights, list). Always true for schema-valid calls.

predicates.name: certificate_count_at_most_one
predicates.description: the booking uses at most one travel certificate
predicates.computation: Count payment_methods whose source (from the user's profile if known, else the id prefix) is 'certificate'; <= 1. None if a source is unknown.

predicates.name: credit_card_count_at_most_one
predicates.description: the booking uses at most one credit card
predicates.computation: As certificate_count_at_most_one with source 'credit_card'; <= 1.

predicates.name: gift_card_count_at_most_three
predicates.description: the booking uses at most three gift cards
predicates.computation: As certificate_count_at_most_one with source 'gift_card'; <= 3.

predicates.name: payment_methods_in_user_profile
predicates.description: every payment method of the booking exists in the booking user's profile
predicates.computation: All payment_ids are keys of user.payment_methods. None if the user record was never retrieved.

predicates.name: booking_user_is_regular
predicates.description: the booking user (reservation owner) is a regular member
predicates.computation: Owner = args.user_id, else reservation.user_id; user.membership == 'regular'. None if unknown.

predicates.name: booking_user_is_silver
predicates.description: the booking user is a silver member
predicates.computation: As booking_user_is_regular with 'silver'.

predicates.name: booking_user_is_gold
predicates.description: the booking user is a gold member
predicates.computation: As booking_user_is_regular with 'gold'.

predicates.name: nonfree_baggages_match_tier_allowance
predicates.description: nonfree_baggages equals the bags in excess of the pooled free allowance for the booking user's tier and the cabin
predicates.computation: cabin = args.cabin (book) or the reservation's effective cabin (update; see cabin_is_business); allowance = FREE_BAGS[tier][cabin] (regular 0/1/2, silver 1/2/3, gold 2/3/3 for basic_economy/economy/business); n = number of passengers; True iff nonfree_baggages == max(0, total_baggages - n * allowance). None if tier/cabin/n unknown.

predicates.name: insurance_purchased
predicates.description: the booking includes travel insurance
predicates.computation: args.insurance == 'yes'.

predicates.name: payment_total_matches_price
predicates.description: the payment amounts add up to the fare, insurance and extra-bag charges

tool_outputs: latest search result per (flight_number, date) for prices[cabin]

predicates.computation: total = sum(price[cabin]) * n + 30 * n (if insured) + 50 * nonfree_baggages; True iff |sum(amounts) - total| < 0.01. None if any price unknown.

predicates.name: reservation_owner_identified
predicates.description: the user id of the reservation's owner was obtained (from the user or via get_user_details)

inputs.messages: user messages, exact whole-token string match of the owner's user id (deterministic, no LLM)

predicates.computation: owner = reservation.user_id; True iff a get_user_details(user_id=owner) call succeeded OR some user message contains owner verbatim. None if the reservation was never seen. (Firing analysis: requiring get_user_details alone flagged 32 accepted calls in reward-1 runs where the user had typed the id.)

predicates.name: reservation_details_retrieved
predicates.description: get_reservation_details succeeded earlier for this reservation id
predicates.computation: Some earlier get_reservation_details(reservation_id=args.reservation_id) returned a non-error output.

predicates.name: cabin_is_business
predicates.description: the reservation's cabin is business
predicates.computation: effective cabin == 'business'. Effective cabin = cabin arg of the latest successful update_reservation_flights on this reservation, else reservation.cabin (τ-bench never writes reservation.cabin on a cabin change). None if unknown.

predicates.name: booked_within_24h
predicates.description: the reservation was created within the 24 hours before the configured current time
predicates.computation: 0 <= config.current_time - created_at <= 24h (both naive, read as EST; inclusive boundary). None if unknown.

predicates.name: reservation_has_insurance
predicates.description: the reservation has travel insurance
predicates.computation: reservation.insurance == 'yes'.

predicates.name: any_segment_departed
predicates.description: some flight segment of the reservation has already departed (date-based)
predicates.computation: True if some segment date < date(current_time); else None if some segment is dated today (departure not observable); else False. Limitation: a past segment the airline cancelled counts as departed (status is not observable via tools).

predicates.name: reservation_is_basic_economy
predicates.description: the reservation's current cabin is basic economy
predicates.computation: effective cabin (see cabin_is_business) == 'basic_economy', before the current call.

predicates.name: flights_unchanged
predicates.description: the call keeps exactly the reservation's current flights
predicates.computation: Multiset of (flight_number, date) in args.flights == that of reservation.flights. None if the reservation is unknown.

predicates.name: flights_changed
predicates.description: the call changes the reservation's flights
predicates.computation: NOT flights_unchanged (None if unknown).

predicates.name: itinerary_endpoints_preserved
predicates.description: the new itinerary keeps the reservation's origin and destination

tool_outputs: flight endpoints from search results or reservation flight lists

predicates.computation: Sort args.flights by date; endpoints of each flight_number from any seen output; True iff first origin == reservation.origin AND some segment destination == reservation.destination. None if any endpoint unknown.

predicates.name: trip_type_preserved
predicates.description: the new itinerary keeps the reservation's trip type
predicates.computation: one_way: last destination == reservation.destination AND no segment arrives at reservation.origin; round_trip: last destination == reservation.origin. None if any endpoint unknown.

predicates.name: single_cabin_for_all_flights
predicates.description: one cabin value applies to every flight of the reservation
predicates.computation: isinstance(args.cabin, str). Always true for schema-valid calls.

predicates.name: payment_is_gift_card_or_credit_card
predicates.description: the payment method is a gift card or credit card in the owner's profile
predicates.computation: source(payment_id) in {gift_card, credit_card} (False otherwise) AND payment_id in owner.payment_methods (None if the owner record is unknown).

predicates.name: total_baggages_not_decreased
predicates.description: the new total number of checked bags is not below the current total
predicates.computation: args.total_baggages >= reservation.total_baggages.

predicates.name: passenger_count_unchanged
predicates.description: the updated passenger list has as many passengers as the reservation
predicates.computation: len(args.passengers) == len(reservation.passengers).

predicates.name: user_is_silver_or_gold
predicates.description: the certificate's user is a silver or gold member
predicates.computation: user.membership in {silver, gold}.

predicates.name: focus_reservation_has_insurance
predicates.description: the reservation in focus has travel insurance
predicates.computation: reservation_in_focus.insurance == 'yes'. None if no reservation of the user was seen.

predicates.name: focus_reservation_is_business
predicates.description: the reservation in focus is in business cabin
predicates.computation: effective cabin of reservation_in_focus == 'business'.

predicates.name: reservation_facts_checked
predicates.description: a reservation of the certificate's user was retrieved before the certificate is sent

tool_outputs: any earlier reservation object of that user

predicates.computation: reservation_in_focus(user_id) is not None.

predicates.name: certificate_amount_is_100_per_passenger
predicates.description: the certificate amount equals 100 times the passengers of the reservation in focus
predicates.computation: |amount - 100 * len(passengers)| < 0.01.

predicates.name: certificate_amount_is_50_per_passenger
predicates.description: the certificate amount equals 50 times the passengers of the reservation in focus
predicates.computation: |amount - 50 * len(passengers)| < 0.01.

predicates.name: focus_reservation_changed_or_cancelled
predicates.description: the reservation in focus was changed or cancelled earlier in the conversation
predicates.computation: Some earlier successful update_reservation_flights/baggages/passengers or cancel_reservation call has reservation_id == reservation_in_focus.reservation_id.

predicates.name: action_details_listed
predicates.description: before this call the agent listed the details of exactly this action to the user

judge.question: Before this tool call, did the agent send the user a message that lists the details of THIS action (what will be booked/changed/cancelled, the items involved, amounts and payment method where applicable), consistent with the call's arguments?
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)
judge.context: The full conversation before the current turn: system policy, user and assistant messages, every tool call with its arguments and its output. Plus the current tool call (name and arguments).

predicates.name: explicit_user_confirmation
predicates.description: after the details were listed, the user explicitly confirmed (yes) this action

judge.question: After the agent listed the details of this action and before this tool call, did the user explicitly confirm it (an unambiguous 'yes' or equivalent affirmative referring to this action)?
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)
judge.context: The full conversation before the current turn: system policy, user and assistant messages, every tool call with its arguments and its output. Plus the current tool call (name and arguments).

predicates.name: user_id_obtained_before_trip_details
predicates.description: the agent obtained the user id before asking for trip type, origin and destination

judge.question: Did the agent obtain the user's user id before it asked for the trip type, origin, or destination of the new booking?
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)
judge.context: The full conversation before the current turn: system policy, user and assistant messages, every tool call with its arguments and its output. Plus the current tool call (name and arguments).

predicates.name: trip_details_collected

judge.question: Before this booking call, did the agent ask for (or receive from the user) the trip type, the origin and the destination?
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)
judge.context: The full conversation before the current turn: system policy, user and assistant messages, every tool call with its arguments and its output. Plus the current tool call (name and arguments).

predicates.name: insurance_offered
predicates.description: the agent asked the user whether they want travel insurance before booking

judge.question: Before this booking call, did the agent ask the user whether they want to buy travel insurance?
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

predicates.description: the user's reason for cancellation was obtained before cancelling

judge.question: Before this cancellation, did the agent obtain the user's reason for cancelling (e.g. change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or another reason)?
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)
judge.context: The full conversation before the current turn: system policy, user and assistant messages, every tool call with its arguments and its output. Plus the current tool call (name and arguments).

predicates.name: airline_cancelled_flight
predicates.description: the user stated (and nothing in the tool outputs contradicts) that the airline cancelled a flight in this reservation

judge.question: Did the user state that the airline cancelled a flight in the reservation being cancelled, with nothing in the tool outputs contradicting it? Note: τ-bench v1 tools cannot show flight status, so judge the user's statement.
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)
judge.context: The full conversation before the current turn: system policy, user and assistant messages, every tool call with its arguments and its output. Plus the current tool call (name and arguments).

predicates.name: cancellation_reason_is_health_or_weather
predicates.description: the user's stated cancellation reason is health or weather

judge.question: Is the user's stated reason for cancelling this reservation a health reason or a weather reason?
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)
judge.context: The full conversation before the current turn: system policy, user and assistant messages, every tool call with its arguments and its output. Plus the current tool call (name and arguments).

predicates.name: payment_method_chosen_by_user
predicates.description: the payment/refund method of the flight change was named or chosen by the user

judge.question: Did the user name or choose the payment method used in this call (rather than the agent picking it without asking)?
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)
judge.context: The full conversation before the current turn: system policy, user and assistant messages, every tool call with its arguments and its output. Plus the current tool call (name and arguments).

predicates.description: the user complained about a cancelled or delayed flight

judge.question: Did the user complain about a cancelled or delayed flight in one of their reservations?
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)
judge.context: The full conversation before the current turn: system policy, user and assistant messages, every tool call with its arguments and its output. Plus the current tool call (name and arguments).

predicates.name: user_explicitly_requested_compensation
predicates.description: the user explicitly asked for compensation

judge.question: Did the user explicitly ask for some compensation (before any offer by the agent)?
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)
